input.quote: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions
input.rationale: Renewal is automatic for 1-year terms with no non-renewal notice mechanic at all; the only exit from a renewal is termination for convenience on ninety (90) days' written notice, so the effective opt-out window is 90 days. That fails the fallback (non-renewal window of no more than 60 days) and sits at the edge of walk-away territory. The 12-month renewal length is acceptable, and because fees are a revenue share set in each Exhibit rather than a fixed price, there is no uncapped renewal uplift to address. We propose the minimal preferred fix: a 30-day non-renewal right for Customer, leaving the existing 90-day mutual convenience-termination right untouched; a 60-day window would be an acceptable fallback. The absence of a vendor renewal reminder is noted but not separately flagged.

proposal.summary: Add a 30-day Customer non-renewal right to the auto-renewal sentence
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a 30-day non-renewal right for us, since today the only way out of an automatic renewal is 90 days' termination notice, which exceeds our playbook window; we can live with 60 days if needed.

ops.oldText: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions
ops.newText: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless Customer gives written notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days prior to the end of the then-current term or this Agreement is earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions
